newsitem.title: USA: BT, MCI to offer US video services.
newsitem.headline: BT, MCI to offer US video services.

text.p: Units of British Telecommunications PLC and MCI Communications Corp on Tuesday said they plan to provide video services to U.S. television broadcasters and media companies.

BT Broadcast Services and MCI Telecommunications said they will offer competitive terrestrial and satellite transmission services within the United States, as well as providing routes for bringing in global programming from Europe and the rest of the world.

BT said the new alliance builds upon Broadcast Services' existing European teleport facilities in London, Paris, Brussels, Cologne and Moscow as well as MCI's four US sites to provide customers with global reach.
"With a simple click of the mouse, broadcasters will be able to control the scheduling and switching of their video traffic globally," MCI said in a statement.
"Our intention is to move quickly in the US market in year one and establish a reputation as a provider of high quality, tailor made transmission solutions," BT said in a statement.
MCI and BT in 1996 agreed to merge to form Concert, a global communications company.
